description: This file defines the React Native screen component 'NoteDetailScreen', which handles viewing, creating, editing, and deleting a note. It interacts with a local storage database via imported functions, manages form state, and provides user interactions such as save and delete.

methods.name: NoteDetailScreen
methods.description: Main functional component for viewing and editing a note, managing state, effects, and user actions.

methods.name: handleSave
methods.description: Handles saving the note, either creating or updating, based on whether the note is new.

methods.name: handleDelete
methods.description: Handles deletion of the note with user confirmation.
